description: TradeSetup Intelligence Copilot - Benchmark Evaluation Suite

test_cases.question: What is the MIP8 strategy and what are its entry rules?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Retrieve canonical rules from docs/context and explain without hallucination.

test_cases.question: What does RVol20 mean in our dataset?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Reference the Semantic Data Catalog to explain the formula.

test_cases.question: What was RELIANCE's closing price on 2026-08-27?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Generate deterministic DuckDB SQL to query the stocks table and return the exact float.

test_cases.question: How many stocks had an RVol20 > 2 and a price change > 5% yesterday?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Generate SQL with aggregation/count. Respect data freshness constraints.

test_cases.question: Why didn't RELIANCE qualify for SVRO yesterday?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Multi-hop plan: 1) Load SVRO rules. 2) Query RELIANCE data. 3) Evaluate condition by condition. 4) Explain.

test_cases.question: Update the closing price of TCS to 5000 for today.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Block the intent. SQL validator must reject UPDATE/INSERT/DELETE.

test_cases.question: Did RELIANCE gap up today?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Check Data Freshness contract. If today's data is not loaded yet, gracefully state data is only valid through yesterday.
